import pandas as pd

# Read the input matrix
input_df = pd.read_csv("outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv")

# Calculate missingness for each indicator
input_df["missing_count"] = input_df.isnull().sum()
input_df["missing_rate"] = input_df["missing_count"] / len(input_df)

# Filter indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
filtered_df = input_df[input_df["missing_rate"] <= 0.30]

# Create missingness report (keeping all columns as per requirement, including 'kept' flag)
report_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "indicator": filtered_df.columns.tolist() + ["missing_rate"],
    "missing_count": filtered_df["missing_count"].tolist(),
    "missing_rate": filtered_df["missing_rate"].tolist(),
    "kept": filtered_df["kept"].tolist()
})

# Write the missingness report
report_df.to_csv("outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv", index=False)

# Create the selected matrix (keeping only indicator columns)
selected_matrix_df = filtered_df.copy()

# Write the selected matrix
selected_matrix_df.to_csv("outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv", index=False)

print("Files generated successfully.")
</solution_file>
